contentText: During a US military operation in Venezuela, troops seized President Nicolás Maduro, and his wife, setting a 'dangerous precedent: any great power can do as it pleases', warns Dr. Gabriel Hetland, Author, Associate Professor of Sociology & Latin American Studies at the University at Albany. For a deeper perspective, Gavin Lee also welcomes Kethevane Gorjestani, Fraser Jackson, Mikey Kay, Journalist and former British Aviation Commander, and Hélène Conway-Mouret, Senator representing French citizens abroad.
